Spamming/Benchmark scripts for case_one (block depth: 0, 8, 32, 64, witness_size: 100mb, 300mb, 500mb). case_one is engine_newPayload + debugExecutionWithness 3. newPayloadWitness impl on GETH + Lighthouse. also logging how much time is take account for JSON serialization and network latency. 4. Spamming/Benchmark scripts for case_two(witness_size: 100mb, 300mb, 500mb) This is more that enough to get the needed data but I am having problem building a block having 100mb, 300mb or 500mb witness size, I was of the opinion, a block filled with tx interacting with a smart contract would blot up the witness size but from my test it was just 0.3mb and randomly sampling mainnet blocks I get an average witness size of 8mb witness. want to know if my chain of thought regarding this is completely flaw. Bench code: https://github.com/developeruche/witness-bench Sample code aiming to build a block of 300mb witness: https://github.com/developeruche/witness-bench/blob/main/spammer/runners/300mb.ts Once I can tune a block to output a witness of 100, 300 and 500mb the bench report would be ready. Would love to know if anyone have some thoughts on how I should go about that? What chain are you using here? Is this a fresh chain with no state? yeah... no state, a local testnet using kurtosis I would propose you do lots of SSTORE against as many different randomised accounts and slots. You can possibly just use a single account and lots of different slots. But the idea is you want to bloat the account and storage tree depth as much as possible using sstore. this makes sense, would modify the scripts to do this

Hey! Want to drop a quick update on this;

1. Lighthouse was modified to to log the time taken to perform `engine_newPaylaod` on an EL, GETH in this case.

2. Spamming/Benchmark scripts for case_one (block depth: 0, 8, 32, 64, witness_size: 100mb, 300mb, 500mb). case_one is engine_newPayload + debugExecutionWithness

3. newPayloadWitness impl on GETH + Lighthouse. also logging how much time is take account for JSON serialization and network latency.

4. Spamming/Benchmark scripts for case_two(witness_size: 100mb, 300mb, 500mb)


This is more that enough to get the needed data but I am having problem building a block having 100mb, 300mb or 500mb witness size, I was of the opinion, a block filled with tx interacting with a smart contract would blot up the witness size but from my test it was just 0.3mb and randomly sampling mainnet blocks I get an average witness size of 8mb witness. want to know if my chain of thought regarding this is completely flaw.


Bench code: https://github.com/developeruche/witness-bench

Sample code aiming to build a block of 300mb witness: https://github.com/developeruche/witness-bench/blob/main/spammer/runners/300mb.ts


Once I can tune a block to output a witness of 100, 300 and 500mb the bench report would be ready. 

Would love to know if anyone have some thoughts on how I should go about that?
